results.query: I was charged twice for my subscription this month, please refund me
results.reply: Hi there! We've seen similar issues before. Could you please DM us with your account's username and email address so we can check it out? Thanks! /TR

results.query: My order never arrived and it's been two weeks
results.reply: Hello, Sorry to hear that your order didn't arrive. Have we missed the advised delivery date? And what's the latest order status?

results.query: The app keeps crashing every time I try to open it after the update
results.reply: We want to help. Can you tell us which steps you've tried so far? This way we won't have you do any steps over again.

results.query: I can't log into my account, it says my password is wrong even though I just reset it
results.reply: Hello, I'm sorry to hear this. Can you please check if your email address matches the one associated with your account? Also, did you receive any notification about password reset from our system?

results.query: This is the third time I've had this problem and nobody has helped me, I'm furious
results.reply: We're sorry to hear you're having trouble again. Our goal is to make things right as soon as possible. Can you please DM us with more details about your issue so we can assist?

results.query: What are your customer service hours?
results.reply: Hi! We have sent you a Direct Message via Twitter with further instructions. Need help? Send me a DM!
